title: Eventual identity and cocycle for specified lifted transitions
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRing a diagram of Noetherian rings, c a limit cone of Spec(R) with affine vertex S, and f:X_i→Spec(R_i) a quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally finitely presented morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. For j≥i write X_j=X_i×Spec(R_j) and X=X_i×S [def-pc-base-change]. Fix a finite affine open cover U of X_j and finitely presented quasi-coherent modules N_a on its members [pqf-def-coherent]. Let M be any module on X. Suppose k≥j and natural overlap transitions T on U×X_k [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions] are supplied, together with isomorphisms of their local objects to the pullbacks of N_a and an invertible component comparison of their limit pullback to the restriction descent data of M. Then at some l≥k the specific canonical pullback T' of T to U×X_l is coherent: it satisfies the identity and triple composition equations on all test schemes. The refinement chart map defining T' is the pullback lift over X_l→X_k, and not a fresh choice of transitions. The limit pullback of T' still admits an invertible component comparison to the restriction descent data of M.

source.place: Lemma limits-lemma-descend-modules-finite-presentation, Tag 01ZR, first proof (Zariski gluing); Algebra Tag 05N7

proof.text: The invertible component comparison implies coherence at the limit by cancellation of its component maps (Comparison.coherent). Test identities on each cover member, and composition on each threefold fiber product of cover members. These are quasi-compact quasi-separated intersections. Choose finite affine covers and apply the equality clause of affine module descent to the finitely many equations between restrictions of the prescribed finite models. Choose a common stage l. Sheaf locality gives the equations on the test schemes.

Naturality and the universal properties of pairwise and threefold fiber products extend the equations to all test schemes. Use the explicit chart refinement maps and their composition equations to identify the transitions with the canonical pullback of T. Transport the limit component comparison by pullback composition isomorphisms; their naturality preserves commutation. Empty covers are vacuous, and the nonempty tail of a preorder is reduced to its partial-order quotient.

proof_origin.place: Expansion of Tag 01ZR first proof; sources read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01ZR and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05N7
